changelog:
Record a programme.

WHAT CHANGED

- Scheduled recording. Turn on Diagnostic mode in Settings and the Diagnostics row "Record a two-minute test" schedules a recording of one of your live channels two minutes out, for two minutes. The phone wakes for it even when it is asleep, records the stream to Movies/MobileIPTV as a .ts file you can play with any player, shows a notice while it records (with Stop) and another when it finishes or fails, saying what happened. Recordings survive a restart of the phone: anything still due is armed again when it starts.
- The first time, the phone asks you to allow "Alarms and reminders" for MobileIPTV; the switch it opens is this app's own.
- When a recording is about to start on a provider whose line is already in use: the phone first looks for the same channel on another of your providers and records from there without touching what is playing; if there is none and the television you paired is using the line, the television asks you — "… is scheduled to record, but would interrupt this stream. Do you want to record or continue watching?" — and records only if you choose Record; if it is this phone's own stream using the line, the phone's stream stops for the recording and tells you.
- A recording that fails offers Retry now in its notice: the same channel, the same length, starting immediately. A recording the phone could not finish because it was switched off or the app was stopped is marked as such and its half-written file is removed. Recordings capture about twenty seconds before and after the programme.

WHAT STAYS THE SAME

- Everything from 0.5.6: live transport controls, Continue watching, the refresh that changes only what changed, the licences page.

NOT YET

- Recording from the guide and the recordings list in the app: for now the test row in Diagnostics is the way to start one. Trimming the padding and compressing a finished recording.
